title: Validate a level name
description:
Write the two checks a level-name field uses:

```cpp
bool allowedChar(char32_t c);                        // the character filter: is this character allowed at all?
std::string validateLevelName(const std::string& name, const std::vector<std::string>& existing);
```

`allowedChar` allows lower-case letters `a`-`z`, digits, `_` and `-`. Everything else is filtered out as it is typed.

`validateLevelName` checks the whole value and returns the **first** problem, or an empty string:

1. empty: `"Give the level a name."`
2. longer than 32 characters: `"Keep the name to 32 characters."`
3. a character `allowedChar` refuses (for text pasted in): `"Use a-z, 0-9, _ and - only."`
4. starts with `-` or `_`: `"Start the name with a letter or digit."`
5. already in `existing` (exact match): `"A level called <name> already exists."`
hints: `allowedChar` is one condition: a lower-case letter, a digit, `'_'` or `'-'`.
In `validateLevelName`, check the rules in the order listed and `return` the message of the first that fails; only if all pass return `""`.
